component.name: OpenDeezer
component.summary: Stream your Deezer library from the desktop

description.p: OpenDeezer is an open-source desktop client for Deezer. Sign in with your own ARL and the whole streaming path runs on your machine: browse your liked songs, playlists, artists and search results, then decode and play the audio locally. Nothing leaves your machine but the requests to Deezer.

ul.li: Browse liked tracks, playlists, albums, artists and charts
Search across tracks, albums, artists and playlists
Gapless playback with a 10-band equalizer and mono downmix
Synced lyrics and a play queue
HiFi (FLAC) and high-quality streaming for paid accounts; free accounts stream the full library at 128 kbps (ad-supported)

description.p: A single Go engine powers the app; this is the unified Linux desktop client (Qt 6 / KDE), which also runs well outside KDE.
Improves search access, compact-screen playback controls, accessibility, loading and error states, and UI reliability across every native and terminal client.
Deezer Free accounts now stream the full library at 128 kbps (ad-supported), download tracks to disk (paid plans) on every client, and a free-only setting to disable ads/play-reporting.
Signed desktop releases and a "No Internet" screen across all clients.
